Looking at the cuboid (4×2×2), I can track the visible cubes of each colour:

- **Dark grey:** the left end column (top front, top back, bottom front) plus the bottom cube of the second column front.
- **Light grey:** the three top front cubes plus the bottom cube of the third column front (a T-shape).
- **Black:** the right end (top back, bottom back, bottom front) plus the hidden bottom back cube of column 3.
- **White:** the two top back cubes in the middle, plus the two hidden bottom back cubes of columns 1 and 2.

So the white piece consists of two cubes in a row on top, with two cubes in a row below shifted one step sideways — a flat "S/Z" (skew) shape lying in the back face of the cuboid. Among the options, this skew planar shape corresponds to option C.
